key_reasoning.reason: New pty.rs Rust command module + state.rs pty field (correlation ID typed slot) + lib.rs invoke registrations + runner-bridge.js pty module + handlers.js runPty/runAction + renderer.js PTY listen wiring — 6 substantive components spanning Rust service, IPC bridge, and JS UI layers.

Four non-trivial sub-problems required review fixes: blocking reader on a dedicated std::thread (not tokio) to avoid starvation (CR pattern), condvar wait_timeout_while with spurious-wakeup guard (CR-003/004), ESRCH kill race when child exits between slot-release and kill call (CR-002), and listener-cleanup ordering when exit-listen throws after data-listen succeeds (CR-005). No single existing pattern covers all four together. Streaming red flag applied: PTY is a continuous real-time output channel — Technical Risk bumped from L to XL.
